description: Generate a reviewable edit proposal, quality audit, deterministic quality comparison, and PATCH payload for a draft, scheduled post, or rough pasted draft. Use edit_mode=full_rewrite for weak/generic/third-person drafts. If the edit needs current facts or data, pass research_policy/source_urls/research_notes or run research first; if it needs authentic POV, pass mini_interview_answers or ask up to three focused questions. This creates an async job only; it does not patch the post.

avoid.description: Phrases, claims, tones, CTAs, or angles the edit should avoid.

diagnostic_notes.description: Optional agent pre-read of weak draft signals, buried hook candidates, missing creator POV, or formatting issues.

evidence_needs.description: Specific facts, benchmarks, claims, or questions the edit should verify or use.

interview_policy.description: auto asks mini-interview questions when authentic creator POV is missing.

mini_interview_answers.description: Creator answers keyed by question or topic. Use for real stories, opinions, proof, and voice.

must_preserve.description: Facts, claims, wording, examples, or constraints that must survive the edit.

quality_bar.description: Review criteria the proposal should satisfy, such as first-person hook, second-line stakes, specific creator insight, mobile scannability, and strong close.

research_notes.description: Concise source-backed findings from web research, or saved research.

research_policy.description: auto runs current research when the edit has fresh-data/news/benchmark signals; required forces it; off disables it.

source_material.description: Rough pasted draft or idea notes when no post_id exists.

source_urls.description: Source URLs to synthesize and weave into the revision when useful.

template_category.description: Optional category hint for matched template inspiration.

name: bamf.generate_post_edit
